title: Cartesian higher-image stage
statement: The pulled-back stage higher image computed by bounded-below derived homology. Its precise parameters and construction are given by the Lean declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.cartesianHigherImageStage; the cartesian objects use the categorical pullbacks of f:X→S and g:T→S, and the stage objects use a cone c over D:I→Over(S).
